reasoning: Round 3 (2026-11-23), rebuilt because the price fell from ~$196 (round 2) to $122.28. What changed: (a) the Lumentum deal was signed on 2026-11-02 at a fixed 4.500 MRVL shares per LITE share (~33% of the combined company), close 1H CY2028, i.e. after the horizon, with preliminary Q3 revenue in line (range narrowed to +/-2%); TD Cowen cut to Hold ($175) and BofA to Neutral ($225); arbitrageurs put completion near 50% (Bloomberg via Trading-Treff) and LITE trades 16.3% under the terms. (b) The midterms: new governors in Ohio, Georgia, Texas and others pledged data-center pauses covering ~40% of planned capacity (Cleanview via Bloomberg); Bloomberg Intelligence sizes 2027 AI infrastructure spend 5-7% lower; I cut CY2027-28 AI capex 4% below the standing view (sourced deviation, newer than the file). NVIDIA's strong Q3 and $130B Q4 guide argue against a demand break, but the sector de-rated sharply (NVDA ~10x the table's NTM EPS at 2026-11-20). (c) Multiples: peers.md P/E repriced to today's closes gives a 23.42x median; MRVL's own 18.6x shrinks to 19.5x by the exit rule; I drop round 2's extra -1.2 turns since today's own multiple already prices MRVL-specific risk. The tech FCF-yield leg (40% of the P/E weight) is now in at the 2.3% peer median. (d) Deal: LITE valued on its own horizon earnings (Zacks, -15% haircut) at its exit-rule multiple, against 456.4M new MRVL shares at my standalone $176.64: V -$9.1B if it closes, p 0.55 = -$5.41/share. Build: FY27 revenue $11.9B (Street $12.07B), FY28 $17.6B (Street $19.7B, management ~$20B), FY29 $24.0B; FY28 non-GAAP EPS $6.38 vs Street $7.37 (-13%: half the share gain management needs, the capex cut, custom-mix GM drag). Result: research target (12m) $171.23 (+40% vs spot; P/E leg alone $162), downside case $69 (P10), upside $327 (P90); left side ln 0.90 vs right 0.65, a fatter left tail. Skeptic evidence that still weighs: insider selling with no buys, SBC ~12% of revenue, China 42% of revenue by ship-to, customer concentration, and a deal whose fixed ratio hands LITE holders a third of the company at a depressed MRVL price. Research used ~14 searches/fetches this round; StockAnalysis FY28-29 figures are paywalled, so FY28 non-GAAP consensus (7.37) is from 24/7 Wall St's relay and FY28-29 revenue from MarketScreener.
